scenarios.name: Place an order
scenarios.reason:
Added Colombia Huila to the bag and opened the bag.
Confirmed that shipping was €4.90 and the bag total was €17.90.
Proceeded to checkout and entered Ada Lovelace’s name, ada@example.com, 12 Rua Augusta, and Lisbon.
Placed the order successfully; order TS-9415 was confirmed as in, with €17.90 charged.

type: Typing Lisbon into city field

analyze: €17.90 was charged.

scenarios.name: Free shipping from €50
scenarios.reason:
Added House Espresso and Paper Filters to the bag and opened the bag.
Confirmed the order summary initially showed €4.90 shipping and a €49.40 total.
Pressed the plus button next to Paper Filters once.
The updated order summary shows free shipping and a €51.00 total.

steps.remark: navigate: Navigate to http://localhost:4173/
click: Clicking Add House Espresso to bag
scroll: Scrolling into view to add Paper Filters to the bag
click: Clicking add paper filters to bag
scroll: Scrolling to the Bag (2) link in the header
click: Clicking Bag (2) to open the bag contents
analyze: the total is €49.40.
assert: shipping is €4.90 and the total is €49.40.
click: Clicking Add one more Paper Filters
analyze: the total is €51.00.
assert: shipping is now Free and the total is €51.00.

scenarios.name: Promo code total
scenarios.reason:
Added Ethiopia Guji to the bag twice and added one Hand Grinder.
Opened the bag and applied the lowercase promo code welcome10.
The discount was −€9.10, shipping was Free, and the final total was €81.90.
